title: Astro's Mixin' Match Pack
description: This Modpack includes the mods I use daily in my main setup, and can be used for just about anything, from testing performance and optimization to aesthetics.
body:
This modpack is my personal daily setup, **combining performance optimization**, **quality-of-life improvements**, and **light visual enhancements**. It is designed to be **flexible** and **usable** for a **variety of playstyles**, from **smooth performance-focused gameplay** to **enhanced visuals and general exploration**.

It includes a balanced mix of **performance mods** like **Sodium** and **Lithium**, helpful utilities such as **Jade** and **Mod Menu**, and **visual improvements** like _shaders_ and **animation tweaks**. The goal is to provide a **smooth and customizable Minecraft experience without heavily changing the core gameplay**.
